rationale: The original thesis relied on price holding firmly above session VWAP, which has now failed as PRCH broke below both VWAP ($20.53) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($20.54) on five consecutive bearish 1-minute candles. Furthermore, riding the trade down to the $19.70 invalidation level would incur a ~$448 loss, which exceeds our remaining daily loss budget of $309.55. Given the strong positive earnings catalyst (+19% gap, 15.37x RVOL), flipping short carries unfavorable tail risk, making an immediate exit the most prudent choice to preserve capital.
